meta.purpose: Compact extract of the photography pass inputs so unit tests and phase B can run in CI, where .plan/ does not exist. Read-only: regenerate from the sources, never edit by hand.

shotlist.source: origin/demo 0a48fc8 (apply, contact, pricing, band-3 placement from wp/03 b41dd8a)

meta.size: `size` is the master the shotlist asked for. The shipped master is `size` scaled down to a long edge of MODEL_MAX_EDGE (1024), see decisions P-1; OG cards are composed from SVG and exempt.
meta.people: `people` is the class from people-policy.json: forbidden, optional or recommended. The shotlist peopleAllowed field is the older all-false version and is not used.

sceneRules: Unnamed and illustrative: no identity, role, employer or customer in alt text or nearby copy.
Chest-down or from behind or at distance: no head, or no face, in frame (tested: 'framed from the chest down so that no head is in the frame' held 3 of 3).
At most two figures in a stage or card image, three in a wide scene; state the count in the prompt ('one person only').
At most one figure image per page, except the three stage images, which ship as a set.
No suits (dark jackets at distance read as a boardroom); knitwear and cardigans in navy, grey and white.
Working at the hand-built model or notebook; no screens, no handshakes, no pointing, no crowd, no eye contact with the camera.
Disclosure line in the footer or About page: Illustrative images are AI-generated and depict no real person or customer.
peoplePolicy.policy: People allowed as unnamed, illustrative scenes on program, services, playbooks, insights and events slots. No people on about, team, contact, trust, pricing, or any slot that could read as our staff, founders, portfolio or testimonials.

register.name: Hive Atlas tabletop
register.statement: One register for every raster: a rendered still life of a hand-built tabletop model (paper, card, matte ceramic, brushed steel, frosted glass, wood), photographed as a physical object on a plain surface. People-free and unmistakably a constructed model, so it reads as illustration and never as documentary evidence of WE. Hexagons are the recurring structural form. The Dream, Build and Grow altitudes appear as survey (flat contours), blueprint (frame and plan) and territory (terrain and fields).
register.lighting: Soft north-window light, long gentle shadows, shallow depth of field, 50mm look, matte surfaces, no lens flare.
register.palette: Deep blue #0F4C81 and blue #1C75BC for main objects, slate #5B5E62 for neutrals, mist #EAF2F9 and white for grounds, charcoal #231F20 only for the deepest shadows; exactly one amber #E8A33D element per image, no more than about 6 percent of the frame.
register.promptSuffix: deep blue, white, soft grey, one small warm amber accent
register.promptStyle: The model takes no negative prompt, so state constraints positively: 'an uninhabited tabletop model of paper and card, nothing written on any surface, one amber element'. Vary the amber object per slot (tile, ribbon, edge, rim, tick) instead of defaulting to a sun.
banned: people, faces, hands, silhouettes, backs of heads
any text, numerals, letters, logos or legible screens
seals, badges, shields, padlocks, checkmarks, certificates (claims C-15, C-24)
scales or gavels as legal symbols; calculators, receipts, invoices
money, price tags, tiers, podiums, trophies, rockets (claims C-06, C-10, C-14, C-16)
generic office, coworking, desk-and-window or golden-hour workspace scenes (stock-photography trope)
globes with network lines, handshakes, hands on keyboards, boardrooms
